title: NoMoreCartPVP
description: This Project disables TNTMinecraft Damage to Players, and block CartPVP
body:
NoMoreCartPVP is a lightweight and easy-to-use Paper plugin that focuses on enhancing PvP safety by preventing TNT minecarts from damaging players. Unlike other plugins that block all explosions, NoMoreCartPVP ensures that normal TNT and other explosive damage remain unaffected, giving server owners fine-grained control over explosive PvP mechanics.

This plugin is perfect for servers that want to allow TNT for environmental purposes, redstone builds, or PvE, but want to protect players from TNT minecart attacks, which are commonly used in unfair PvP tactics.
